tools.name: Orca
tools.why: Only GUI orchestrator we could drive end-to-end on Linux: headless runtime, scriptable CLI, 18/18 stub tasks verified across 3 logged clean runs, survived restarts.
tools.who: Teams and solo builders on any OS who want a GUI they can also script.
pros: Headless runtime and full CLI. We drove the whole suite without a display
Concurrent worktree creation, crash isolation, terminals that survive restarts
35+ agents, SSH remotes, mobile companion, MIT
cons: About 1.1 GB peak RSS for 6 tiny sessions
Ships several builds a day and its orchestration layer is still experimental
8.6k open issues+PRs, and a star count we cannot explain

facts.platforms: macOS, Windows, Linux (AppImage/deb/rpm), iOS + Android companion; headless `orca serve` runtime
facts.agents: Any terminal agent; README lists 35+ incl. Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Copilot, OpenCode, Amp, Antigravity, Pi, Devin, Goose, Cline, Droid, Kiro, Qwen Code...
facts.parallel: Worktree per task; fan one prompt across N agents; experimental Runs/Tasks/supervised workers (DAG) via CLI
facts.review: Diff review; GitHub/GitLab/Linear/Jira linking; PR/MR fields on worktrees
facts.remote: Strong: mobile companion, remote runtimes via pairing, SSH
facts.mcp: Not verified (CLI + bundled agent skills are the documented control surface)
facts.cost: Account/usage features exist (e.g. 'codex reset credit', 'Configure usage tracking' in UI); depth not verified
facts.setup: Install app (onboarding detected OpenCode and offered 44 more agents) or `orca serve`

tools.bugs: 8.6k open issues+PRs; ships multiple builds per day (v1.4.230), so behaviour moves fast. 'Orchestration' layer is flagged Experimental in docs.
tools.notes: GitHub reports ~97.9k stars, unusually high for a 7-month-old repo; we did not audit star provenance.

tools.name: T3 Code

delegate_task across providers, plus an MCP that lets agents manage threads
One-click PR with draft and stacked PRs; web and mobile
cons: We could not run a session here: it controls agents that are installed and authenticated, and none were
2.9k open issues+PRs; v0.1.0 is days old
Users on X report the sidebar gets noisy at scale
